reading: An old hash is invalid in both senses the requirement can mean. Presented against the current revision it is refused proposal_digest_mismatch, because the content it describes is no longer that proposal; presented against the predecessor it is refused proposal_not_proposed, because accepting a revision retires its predecessor. The control shows the current digest is still accepted, so the refusals are about the hash being old rather than about acceptance being broken.
what_this_replaces: the earlier wrong-digest case, which used an all-zero value and therefore showed only that a wrong digest is refused
